pending_interview.question: You are given a list of log entries. Each entry is a string in the format "timestamp user_id page_id", where timestamp is an integer representing seconds since epoch. A "session" is defined as a sequence of page visits by the same user where no two consecutive visits are more than 30 minutes apart. Write a function that, given the list of log entries, returns the user_id with the longest single session (by total time: last visit minus first visit in that session). Describe your approach, its time complexity (a measure of how the runtime grows as input size grows), and the space complexity (a measure of how much memory it uses). What edge cases would you handle?
